SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 2, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
With the exception of Item 4, all agenda items will be held concurrently with the Wednesday, April 2, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting agenda.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Annual Reorganization of the Planning Commission
This item will be considered immediately following the Roll Call item listed on the Wednesday, April 2, 2025 Planning Commission Regular Meeting agenda.
5.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
6.
Adjournment

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Special Planning Commission Meeting
April 2, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703
With the exception of Item 3B aIt agenda items listed below were considered concurrently
with the Wednesday, April 2, 2025 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting
agenda.
1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Director of Community Development KrIstin
  Aguila.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commissionwere declared present, except
  CommissionerJhaveri, who was noted absent.

3B.  Annual Reorganization of the Planning Commission

This item was considered immediately following the Roll Call Item 3 listed on the
Wednesday, April 2, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting agenda.

  Community Development Director Kristin Aguila declared the position of Chair of
  the Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Reyes nominated Commissioner Pulido for Chair. Commissioner
  Chauhan seconded the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  Commissioner Pulido was declared Chair unanimously.

  Community Development Director Kristin Aguila declared the position of Vice
  Chair of the Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Chair Pulido nominated Commissioner Reyes for Vice Chair. Commissioner Ao
  secondedthe nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  Commissioner Reyes was declared Vice Chair.

6.  New and Old Business
6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTIONOF
  THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-4, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTYOWNERS TO DEMOLISH AN
  EXISTING SINGLE-STORY RESIDENCE AND DETACHED GARAGE AND
  CONSTRUCT A NEW TWO-STORY RESIDENCE AT 19200 BECHARD AVENUE,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTYIS ZONED SINGLE-
  FAMILYRESIDENTIAL(RS-6500) (APN 7044-002-012).#

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Metr6 Anthony. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and
  existing property conditions that do not comply with existing Cerritos Municipal
  Code requirements. Mr. Anthony provided details about the installation of a new
  public pedestrian walkway and parkway tree proposed under the project subject to
  the dedication of a parkway easement to the City. Discussionfollowed regarding the
  design of the new residence, exterior doors, and the design and location of proposed
  balconiesat the rear of the residence.

  Chair Pulido opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no other speakers, Chair
  Pulido declared the public hearing closed.

  MOTION: it was moved by Commissioner Chauhan and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2025-4: A RESOLUTIONOFTHE

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:
